method: Read-only probes: `<cli> --version`, `<cli> --help`, `node bin/deckweft.mjs doctor` and `node bin/deckweft.mjs doctor --host both` (the existing src/hosts/capabilities.mjs probeHost, authentication not probed). No login, no model request, no configuration change. Skill locations were checked for existence only.

stateMeaning.installed: the executable answered --version in this environment
stateMeaning.skillInstalled: a DeckWeft skill directory exists where the host looks for it
stateMeaning.authenticated: a login status probe succeeded; 'not-probed' when it was not run
stateMeaning.invokedForDwi: the host ran a DeckWeft task for a DWI phase, with a receipt
stateMeaning.exportedForDwi: that run produced an export that was opened and inspected

hosts.slidesNote: `codex --help` lists no slides command; no documented Slides or Spaces API was found. Nothing is built against one.
hosts.priorEvidence: docs/evidence/dw-020 (Codex CLI 0.160.0 skill route, 2026-10-17) and docs/evidence/vis-012 (v3 draft and revision). Those receipts certify their own commits, not this one.
docs/evidence/vis-012: version/help probes only; the Claude login and live task stay deferred.

hosts.slidesNote: This DWI implementation session itself runs in the Claude desktop app (Code tab). It edits the repository; it is not a DeckWeft host invocation and certifies nothing about the host loop.
